Just double checking my cluster analysis

this time going to try using k-means clustering

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)

set.seed(42)  # important for reproducibility — k-means is random initialisation

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Scale the same two variables as before
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slopes_mat_km <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("site") %>%
  select(slope, vpd_at_peak) %>%
  scale()

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: Fit k-means with k = 3
# nstart = 25 means it tries 25 random initialisations and keeps the best
# this reduces sensitivity to the random starting point
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
km_fit <- kmeans(slopes_mat_km, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Verify k = 3 is optimal using silhouette score
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sil_scores_km <- map_dbl(2:6, function(k) {
  km <- kmeans(slopes_mat_km, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  mean(silhouette(km$cluster, dist(slopes_mat_km))[, 3])
})

sil_table_km <- tibble(k = 2:6, silhouette = round(sil_scores_km, 3))
cat("\n── K-means silhouette scores ──\n")
print(sil_table_km)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Assign cluster labels — ordered by mean slope
# most negative slope = High sensitivity
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
site_slopes_km <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_raw = factor(km_fit$cluster))

# Get mean slope per raw cluster to determine label order
cluster_means_km <- site_slopes_km %>%
  group_by(cluster_raw) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope    = mean(slope,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_intercept = mean(intercept,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_vpd_peak = mean(vpd_at_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_slope)  # most negative = High sensitivity

cat("\n── K-means cluster summary ──\n")
print(cluster_means_km)

level_order_km <- cluster_means_km$cluster_raw

# Recode raw cluster numbers to Low / Medium / High
site_slopes <- site_slopes_km %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_multi = fct_recode(cluster_raw,
      "High"   = as.character(level_order_km[1]),
      "Medium" = as.character(level_order_km[2]),
      "Low"    = as.character(level_order_km[3])
    ),
    cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))
  )

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Verify — check mean slope and n per labelled cluster
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n── Labelled cluster verification ──\n")
site_slopes %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = round(mean(slope), 3),
    n          = n(),
    sites      = paste(site, collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  print()

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: Rebuild cluster objects for plotting
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cluster_lookup  <- site_slopes %>% select(site, cluster_multi)
all_clouds_cl   <- all_clouds   %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")
fitted_lines_cl <- fitted_lines %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")

site_order <- site_slopes %>%
  arrange(cluster_multi, slope) %>%
  pull(site)

all_clouds_cl   <- all_clouds_cl   %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))
fitted_lines_cl <- fitted_lines_cl %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))
site_slopes_cl  <- site_slopes     %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 7: Cluster summary plot — three panels with mean slope line
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cluster_colours <- c(
  "Low"    = "#44AA99",
  "Medium" = "#DDCC77",
  "High"   = "#AA4499"
)

cluster_mean_params <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope     = mean(slope,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_intercept = mean(intercept,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_vpd_peak  = mean(vpd_at_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites        = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_mean_lines <- cluster_mean_params %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    cluster_multi = cluster_multi,
    n_sites       = n_sites,
    mean_slope    = mean_slope,
    mean_vpd_peak = mean_vpd_peak,
    vpd_mid       = seq(mean_vpd_peak, 6, by = 0.05),
    fitted        = mean_intercept + mean_slope * vpd_mid
  )

cluster_labels <- cluster_mean_params %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("n = ", n_sites, " sites\nMean β = ", round(mean_slope, 3))
  )

p_cluster_summary <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data  = all_clouds_cl,
    aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = cluster_multi),
    size  = 0.3, alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data      = fitted_lines_cl,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, group = site, colour = cluster_multi),
    linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data      = cluster_mean_lines,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = cluster_multi),
    linewidth = 1.4, alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data     = cluster_mean_params,
    aes(xintercept = mean_vpd_peak, colour = cluster_multi),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data        = cluster_labels,
    aes(label   = label, colour = cluster_multi),
    x           = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust       = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size        = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
    ncol   = 3,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours, name = "Sensitivity") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
  labs(
    title = "GPP–VPD response by sensitivity cluster (k-means, k = 3)",
    x     = "VPD (kPa)",
    y     = "Normalised GPP"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_cluster_summary)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 8: Dot plot of slopes wet to dry coloured by cluster
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ggplot(site_slopes %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)),
       aes(x = site, y = slope, colour = cluster_multi)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  labs(
    x      = "Site (Wet to Dry)",
    y      = "GPP~VPD Slope",
    colour = "Sensitivity",
    title  = "GPP sensitivity clusters (k-means)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
